editorialNotes: Commercial mismatches: RU notIncluded lists eco-tax amounts for Iguazu, Buenos Aires and Bariloche absent from approved Word; RU price USD 388 for Glaciares Gourmet and USD 336 for Todo Glaciares conflict with Word Price on request. EN follows approved Word, Premium +USD 153 retained. No original source or prices changed.

blocks.text: Safari Náutico boat trip at the Perito Moreno Glacier

provenance.wordAbsenceReason: The approved Word confirms the Safari Nautico boat trip as an included part of Perito Moreno Day 7, but has no independent website included field.

blocks.text: Eco taxes, payable per night per passenger at check-out

provenance.wordAbsenceReason: The approved Word requires eco taxes to be paid per night per passenger at check-out but provides none of the RU-specific Iguazu, Buenos Aires or Bariloche monetary estimates; those unconfirmed rates were not asserted in EN.

blocks.text: Medical insurance and trip cancellation insurance

provenance.wordAbsenceReason: The approved Word lists medical and trip-cancellation insurance as excluded, but does not contain a separate website notIncluded field.

provenance.wordAbsenceReason: The approved Word lists extras and services not mentioned as excluded, but not a standalone website item in this form.
